messages.text: Can you make an rz view of the old and new routing proposal ?
I’ll draw the two routes side by side, showing the cryostats, HCAL boundaries and pipe bends. I’ll label the proposed necks and clearances as conceptual so the view doesn’t imply a validated fit.

I’ll keep the detector positions identical in the main comparison so the routing change is clear. I’ll also make a separate view of the conditional 400 mm gap target, with the HCAL boundaries left fixed.

The views now show the bend moving from the front gap into the barrel-side neck. The target-gap view also shows that moving the ECAL inward adds rear space inside the HCAL bore; the full radial exit window remains 500 mm. The PNG and SVG files reproduce byte for byte from the pinned inputs.

The visual review found that I’d used the wrong component colours. I’m correcting the figures to the project’s yellow ECAL and orange HCAL palette and checking the label contrast. The geometry and gap annotations passed the review.
The final visual review has no remaining findings. I’m adding the reviewed PNG/SVG views and their reproduction recipe to draft PR #142, including the separate 400 mm gap study.

**Old routing on the left; proposed side-neck routing on the right.** Both retain the 800 mm front gap to isolate the routing change.

![Old and proposed LAr routing in RZ]([redacted]

The separate **[400 mm gap study view]([redacted] shows the conditional inward endcap move. The full rear radial-exit window remains 500 mm.
